# eon_action_approval_rules (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of action approval rules in the Eon project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List all action approval rules
data "eon_action_approval_rules" "all" {}

output "action_approval_rule_ids" {
  description = "IDs of all action approval rules"
  value       = [for r in data.eon_action_approval_rules.all.rules : r.id]
}

data "eon_action_approval_rules" "restore" {
  operation = "RESTORE_RESOURCE"
}

output "restore_approval_rules" {
  description = "Rules that protect restore operations"
  value       = [for r in data.eon_action_approval_rules.restore.rules : r.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `operation` (String) Optional filter for rules by the action they protect. Supported values: `ADD_RESTORE_ACCOUNT`, `CREATE_BACKUP_POLICY`, `RESTORE_RESOURCE`, `UPDATE_BACKUP_POLICY`, `DELETE_BACKUP_POLICY`, `REMOVE_SNAPSHOT_HOLD`.

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) List of action approval rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `approval_window_hours` (Number) Hours the request stays open for approval before expiring.
- `description` (String) Optional description of the rule.
- `execution_window_hours` (Number) Hours after approval during which the approved action can be executed.
- `id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the rule.
- `operation` (String) Action this rule protects.
- `required_approvals` (Number) Number of approvals required before the action can be executed.
